def pin(p):return {'path':str(Path(p)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def iso(t):return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(t.replace('Z','+00:00')).isoformat(timespec='milliseconds').replace('+00:00','Z')

 p='.superpowers/m80-foundation-hosted-live001-'+name+'.json'
 with open(p,'xb') as f:f.write((json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n').encode());f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 return pin(p)
def verified(pin_value):

"""Publish only the final reviewed M80 hosted preparation manifest to rolling PR6."""
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve();BASE='ec02446b3b529db68e2d2d7b2cfc50b0aaaaadcd'
MANIFEST=Path('.superpowers/m80-hosted-portability-publication-manifest.json')
INTENT=Path('.superpowers/m80-hosted-portability-publication-intent.json');RECEIPT=Path('.superpowers/m80-hosted-portability-published.json')
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','gc.auto=0',*args])
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def exclusive(p,v):
 with p.open('xb') as f:f.write((json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n').encode());f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
def main():
 assert not INTENT.exists() and not RECEIPT.exists(),'Prior publication attempt: inspect without replay'
 m=json.loads(MANIFEST.read_bytes());assert m['profile']=='neuvetra.m80.reviewed-hosted-publication.v1' and m['base']==BASE
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==BASE and git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()=='codex/corporate-mvp'
 assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
 paths=[r['path'] for r in m['files']];assert len(paths)==len(set(paths)) and paths
 for r in m['files']+m['reviews']:
  p=Path(r['path']);assert not p.is_absolute() and p.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT) and '.superpowers' not in p.parts
  assert sha(p)==r['sha256'],r['path']
 subprocess.run(['python','tools/agent_ops.py','validate'],check=True)
 exclusive(INTENT,{'base':BASE,'manifest_sha256':sha(MANIFEST),'branch':'codex/corporate-mvp','no_automatic_replay':True})
 pathspec=Path('.superpowers/m80-hosted-portability-publication-paths.nul')
 with pathspec.open('xb') as f:f.write(b'\0'.join(x.encode() for x in paths)+b'\0');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 git('add','--pathspec-from-file='+str(pathspec),'--pathspec-file-nul')
 assert set(git('diff','--cached','--name-only').decode().splitlines())==set(paths)
 for r in m['files']:assert hashlib.sha256(git('show',':'+r['path'])).hexdigest()==r['sha256'],r['path']
 git('diff','--cached','--check')
 git('commit','-m','Make Scope 1 upgrade review evidence portable')
 head=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip();assert git('rev-parse','HEAD^').decode().strip()==BASE
 for r in m['files']:assert hashlib.sha256(git('show',head+':'+r['path'])).hexdigest()==r['sha256'],r['path']
 git('push','origin','HEAD:refs/heads/codex/corporate-mvp')
 remote=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/codex/corporate-mvp').decode().split()[0];assert remote==head
 exclusive(RECEIPT,{'head':head,'remote':remote,'manifest_sha256':sha(MANIFEST),'pr':'https://github.com/neuvetra-hq/neuvetra/pull/6','checks':'pending','hosted_mutation':False})
 print(json.dumps({'status':'published_reviewed_hosted_preparation','head':head,'files':len(paths),'checks':'pending'}))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
